key_insight: Multi-turn LLM dialogues can feel helpful for NFR assessment, but agreement with users does not guarantee accurate compliance judgments.
engineering_relevance: For AI-assisted software engineering, this highlights the need to evaluate both answer correctness and conversational quality when using LLMs for vague, context-heavy requirements like HIPAA compliance.
method: They evaluated 148 HIPAA-derived NFRs on the iTrust codebase
Assessments covered satisfaction level, reasoning, and code localization
evidence_signal: In the study, developers often agreed with the LLM, but comparison to expert ground truth showed low accuracy.
watch_item: High user satisfaction may mask poor compliance accuracy, so deployment should not rely on conversational confidence alone.
paper_title: Accuracy and Satisfaction in Multi-Turn LLM Dialogues for NFR Assessment
